_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Hope band inside a documented coil (±2pt moves in only 6% of recent windows) with diverging momentum/funding/mvrv versus the 2019 analog and no confirmed breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls Hope/HOLD/CAUTION on crypto cycle; narrative supplies unrelated crude oil headline without a forward phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC range holds and F&G stays ~55-70 with funding near flat and ETF/stablecoin flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum lifts through the mid-70s with funding and ETF or stablecoin flows turning up, or price loses the range while VIX/skew stay pinned
